item.title: Local students share stories through art in after-school program
item.description: Educator Jessica Held guides local students in creating art from their favorite stories, showcasing their work in libraries across Southeast Ohio.

item.title: 'Heavily Soiled': horns, humor, and high-grade trashcan rock
item.description: Massive Hot Dog Recall’s "Heavily Soiled" blends lowbrow absurdity, Rust Belt charm, and surprisingly tight musicianship.

item.title: Local police say there is no truth to rumors that ICE agents raided Ohio University dorms
item.description: The Athens police chief and a captain with the university police department told WOUB they are unaware of any raids by ICE.

item.description: ATHENS, Ohio (WOUB) — The new era of Ohio Volleyball is officially underway. Ohio Director of Athletics Slade Larscheid announced that the interim tag has been removed for Kenzie Brinkman,... Read More

item.title: Showing Teeth talks about her debut single 'Labyrinth'
item.description: Showing Teeth shares how car demos, persistence, and Appalachian grit shaped her voice and her debut single “Labyrinth” in this WOUB Q&A.

item.title: Three eerie early films from Yorgos Lanthimos - WOUB Public Media
item.description: Dr. Gordon Briggs spotlights three Yorgos Lanthimos films, exploring the director’s signature blend of isolation, absurdity, and dark humor.

item.title: Scott Hamilton talks Rust Belt Rock and Nashville arena show
item.description: Scott Hamilton reflects on his Ohio roots and previews his Nashville arena show blending rock artists, elite skaters, and cancer research.

item.title: Ohio lawmakers advanced an overnight deal on cannabis and a hemp law overhaul
item.description: A six-member committee of state lawmakers met to recommend a slew of changes to cannabis statute as well as a ban on intoxicating hemp.

item.title: Athens City Council approved zoning changes to create a neighborhood business hub along Columbus Road
item.description: The Athens City Council approved a plan to rezone the old fire station on Columbus Road and the area around it for commercial development.
